name: tei-scholar
description: TEI editing for Indological texts: TEI P5 validation and pop-up documentation, Devanagari/IAST font profiles and transliteration, and word-processor-style footnotes stored in <standOff>.

commands.title: Open TEI Documentation for Element at Cursor
Jump Between Footnote Anchor and Note
Go to Note of Footnote at Cursor
Go Back to Footnote Anchor in Text

teiScholar.footnotes.noteLang.description: Value of xml:lang on new <note> elements.

teiScholar.footnotes.standOffTypes.markdownDescription: Choices for the `@type` of a note's `<standOff>`, offered in the Footnote pane (which also offers **Custom…**). Each type gets its own `<standOff>` per passage; within a passage they are written in this order. The first one is the default.

teiScholar.footnotes.contextElements.markdownDescription: Which enclosing elements supply the `XXX` in `XXX-n1`. Empty = the nearest enclosing element that has an `xml:id`. Example: `["lg", "p"]` to always use the line group even when an `<l>` has its own id.

teiScholar.footnotes.indent.description: Indentation unit for new <standOff>/<note> lines. Empty = use the editor's tab settings.

teiScholar.footnotes.fontFamily.description: Font for the footnote pane. Empty = same as the XML editor font.

teiScholar.footnotes.fontSize.description: Font size for the footnote pane. 0 = same as the XML editor.

teiScholar.footnotes.foreignLang.description: xml:lang used by the 'foreign' button in the footnote pane.

teiScholar.footnotes.followCursor.description: When the footnote pane is open, show the note of whichever anchor the cursor is on.

teiScholar.footnotes.revealOnAnchor.description: Open the footnote pane automatically when the cursor lands on a footnote anchor.

teiScholar.footnotes.deleteNoteWithAncho.markdownDescription: When a footnote `<anchor/>` is deleted from the text, delete its `<note>` too (and its `<standOff>` if it becomes empty). If the anchor was cut and is pasted back in the same file, the note is restored.

teiScholar.footnotes.atomicAnchors.markdownDescription: Treat an `<anchor/>` like a footnote mark: Backspace just after it, or Delete just before it, removes the whole anchor and its note in one step.

teiScholar.footnotes.backLinks.markdownDescription: Show *↑ back to text* and *edit in pane* links above each footnote `<note>` in the standOff area.

teiScholar.footnotes.showNumbers.description: Show running footnote numbers (¹ ² ³) after anchors in the editor. Display only; nothing is written to the file.

teiScholar.help.hoverOnText.description: Hovering over text shows the element path (e.g. TEI › text › body › div › lg › l) with links to the TEI Guidelines.

teiScholar.help.maxListLength.description: Maximum number of elements listed under 'May contain' / 'Contained by' in hovers.

teiScholar.schema.useBundledSchema.description: Register a catalog with Red Hat XML so the standard tei_all.rng URL resolves to the bundled copy (offline, faster).

teiScholar.schema.offerAssociation.description: Offer to add a tei_all schema declaration to TEI files that have none.

teiScholar.translit.avagraha.description: Character written for avagraha (ऽ) when converting Devanagari to IAST, e.g. ' or ’.

teiScholar.fontProfiles.markdownDescription: Font profiles offered by **TEI: Choose Font Profile**. `fontFamily` is a CSS list: characters missing from the first font fall back to the next, so put a Latin/IAST font first and a Devanagari font after it.
